svg.title: An animated R3000A pipeline. One instruction enters the five stages every cycle, so from cycle five onward five instructions are in flight at once and one finishes per cycle. A timeline below records the same nine cycles.
svg.text: One instruction enters every cycle. By cycle 5, all five stages are busy at once.
The same nine cycles, as a timeline.
The diagonal of IF cells is pc, fetching a new instruction every cycle.
